title: WordPress serialized theme references follow ID maps without false Preview changes
steps: Run real MariaDB typed-reference and shell Sync/Preview cases, plus the changeset controls.
expect: Logos and headers follow collided live attachment IDs while dimensions remain unchanged.
Posts and terms use their own ID maps without cascading batch replacements.
Serialized-only references reserve fresh IDs and receive remembered mappings.
Preview and a second Sync report no false theme change.
Unsafe PHP aliases and unreadable reference containers are refused rather than corrupted.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=theme mod references|serialized-only theme|typed theme|logo and header follow|theme header references
tests: theme mod references renumber by entity and path without changing dimensions or cascading IDs
serialized-only theme references reserve fresh IDs and receive remembered mappings
typed theme references retain byte lengths, Unicode and opaque payloads while refusing unsafe aliases
WordPress logo and header follow attachment renumbering through Sync and the next Preview
WordPress theme header references after Sync produce no false preview (array)
